entry.description: With `StaticLogFileName` a `DatePattern` such as `.dd` named dated files like numbered backups, so a roll could overwrite one with the other. Such an appender is now reported when activated and uses the dated file name as with `StaticLogFileName` false, so its backups are numbered after the date, and an existing static file is left untouched, including its numbered backups. Use a `DatePattern` with a separator or at least five digits to keep the static name (reported by @Snotface, fixed by @FreeAndNil)
